'''Quantum bombs''' were a devastating weapon developed by [[Arkanian/Legends|Arkanian]] researchers looking for an alternate energy source. The bomb broke the connections of elementary particles at a subatomic level, obliterating any matter within a radius of 20,000 to 50,000 kilometers. Such variable range made quantum bombs an unpredictability and they were rarely used during warfare. Despite this, the [[Eternal Empire]] of [[Zakuul]] used quantum bombs during the [[Eternal Empire conquest]] conflicts, such as the [[occupation of Denon]]. Zakuulan military officer [[Koth Vortena]] witnessed the destruction of [[Denon/Legends|Denon]] fleet, which pushed him to defect and later join the [[Eternal Alliance|Alliance]] against Zakuul.<ref name="SWTOR" />

Koth installed one quantum bomb on the ''[[Gravestone]]'' vessel to prevent it from falling into enemy hands. However, it proved a liability when the ship was taken over by [[SCORPIO]] and [[Vaylin]] with Koth still onboard and the Alliance fleet nearby. Koth and [[Alliance Commander|the Alliance Commander]] had to defuse bomb fuses throughout the ship and after the bomb was triggered anyway during Vaylin's fight with [[Lana Beniko]], he barely had the time to disarm the main component manually.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
A quantum bomb appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne]]'' during '''"Chapter III: Dark Reunions."'''
